title: Top white line at Dock pinned to bottom in Dark Mode

judgment.rationale: Current main already contains a Dock frame-gap fix that matches the 1px bright line shown in this dark-mode Dock report.
evidence: The issue shows a thin bright line above a bottom-pinned Dock in dark mode.
A follow-up comment says toggling the material to transparent and back to acrylic removes the line temporarily.
Current-main history includes “Dock: Remove our last 1px gap once and for all” (#49641), which fixes a WinUI titlebar offset that left a visible 1px gap.
judgment.recommended_action: Link the handled-by-main Dock frame-gap fix and verify the report against a build newer than 0.100.2 rather than designing a new fix.

fix_assessment.rationale: The current-main Dock frame-gap fix is the most direct public match for the reported white-line symptom.

issue_context.summary: This report shows a thin white line above a bottom-pinned Command Palette Dock in dark mode, and current main now contains a dedicated 1px Dock gap fix that likely covers that visual artifact.
known_information: The body includes a screenshot of a bottom-pinned dark Dock with a bright top line.
The reporter and follow-up comment identify acrylic/transparent material switching as a temporary workaround.
The issue is tagged for Command Palette and Settings on PowerToys 0.100.2.
inferences: The workaround and symptom both point to Dock window chrome/backdrop layout rather than to a content-rendering issue inside individual Dock items.
A one-pixel top line is consistent with the current-main fix that removed a 1px Dock frame gap caused by WinUI titlebar offset behavior.
issue_context.analysis: The most honest lightweight update is that this now appears handled by existing Dock work. The issue text is specific, the current-main fix targets the same one-pixel gap family, and there is no newer contrary evidence in the thread.
initial_investigation: Recent history for src/modules/cmdpal/Microsoft.CmdPal.UI/Dock/DockWindow.xaml.cs includes PR #49641, which removed the remaining 1px gap from Dock window chrome handling.
The issue’s workaround of switching materials lines up with a backdrop/frame problem instead of with a settings-data problem.

actions.label: Link handled dock frame-gap fix

comment.body: Thanks for the screenshot and workaround details. Current main now has a targeted Dock frame-gap fix in #49641 that removes the remaining 1px offset in the Dock window chrome path, which appears to match the bright line shown here. Since this report was filed against 0.100.2 before that merge, the next maintainer step is to verify it on a build that includes #49641 and then close it as handled if the line no longer appears.
